'''Ealsin''' was [[Perrin]]'s great aunt. 

== Appearance ==
She had a sharp nose.

==Activities==
She lived on the Aybara farm with the rest of Perrin's family. [[Padan Fain]] murders Perrin's entire family including Ealsin. Their deaths are blamed on Trollocs.{{ref/book|4|29}}
